attempts.summary: Configured a persistent ufw firewall on node1 via Ansible (run from control node4): SSH allowed from any address, TCP 9000 allowed only from node2, and TCP 9000 rejected from node3 and everywhere else (default incoming policy deny). Verified with real listener/connection tests from node2/node3/node4, then performed the mandatory sequential restart of all four nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart re-verification.
